versions.changelog:
3gpp-scout v1.2.0

- Expanded index: Now covers Rel-15 through Rel-20 and 8,700+ document versions (~2.6M+ vectors).
- Added deduplication: Text and image search endpoints now support deduplication across releases/versions (with an also_in field).
- Usage & quota updates: Monthly request limits clarified for all access methods; errors on quota exhaustion now provide detailed, machine-readable responses.
- Enhanced MCP support: Instructions and endpoints updated for OAuth 2.1 and hosted MCP integration.
- Updated skill documentation and removed the redundant skill-card.md file.
- General improvements to search parameter options and result metadata.

Version 1.0.2

- Updated environment variable for API key from THREEGPP_SCOUT_API_KEY to SCOUT_API_KEY.
- Added OpenClaw skill metadata specifying required environment variable and its preferred usage.
- Updated authentication instructions to include methods for setting the API key via environment variable or OpenClaw config.
- No functional or endpoint changes detected.

- Added full provider disclosure (Carrot Labs), pricing transparency (paid API with free starter credits for new accounts), declared credential (THREEGPP_SCOUT_API_KEY env var), and links to homepage, terms, and privacy policy
- Synced endpoint docs with latest API (added text_match_threshold, image_match_threshold, section_token_count) and added a Data & Privacy section

Initial release of 3gpp-scout agent skill.

- Provides semantic search over 3GPP technical specifications via the 3GPP Scout API.
- Supports text, image, and combined (text + image) search endpoints.
- Enables filtering by release, document number, series, document type, and section.
- Additional endpoints to list documents, fetch section contents, retrieve document TOCs, and access extracted images.
- Corpus includes major 3GPP releases such as Rel-15 and Rel-19.
